answer: Because your car is still registered in Texas, Texas's duplicate title rules apply, not Georgia's, even though you now live in Georgia. Since the car is paid off, we can't complete the purchase until you have a duplicate title. You can still get an offer and book an appointment while you wait. The help center doesn't say how long a Texas duplicate takes, so please contact a store for that timing.

facts.fact: the duplicate rules of the state that issued the title (Texas) apply
Texas titles are electronic, so for the sale you usually don't need a printed duplicate
a printed Texas duplicate takes 5 to 7 business days online
